title: Effects of High Protein Diet on the Large Intestine in Overweight Humans
brief_summary: This study aims at evaluating the consequences of a 3 weeks high protein diet on the large intestine ecosystem (microbiota, metabolites and gene expression in rectal mucosa). Those parameters will be analysed with technics including OMICs methods. After a run-in period, 42 volunteers will receive either soy or milk protein or maltodextrin as a placebo control. This trial is double blind randomized placebo-controlled paralleled design (3 arms). Longitudinal sampling will allow the comparison of parameters during the study.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* BMI 25- 30
* Body weight stable last 3 months
* Moderate physical activity

Exclusion Criteria:

* Abnormal food behavior
* Digestive, renal, hepatic, pulmonary, hemostasis, neoplasic diseases
* antibiotic, pre or probiotics use in the last 3 months
* intolerance for the tested product
* positive serology for infectious disease
* pregnancy
